actual_scope: Audit the PR49 historical arithmetic checker for omitted supplier-to-assembly saving equality; reproduce a positive-domain arithmetic counterexample and supply an opt-in equality guard.

stop_rule: Stop after authenticated historical CLI reproduction, an independent exact consumed-moment lower bound, fixed-receipt controls, and a bounded equality guard. Do not rerun finite-count producers or change frozen helpers.
